correctness.rationale: Beta radial moments h_j give orthonormal signed monomial Fourier basis and a genuine bilateral shift T_m e_k=w_k e_(k+m), with three explicit angular regimes. Reflection w_(-m-k)^2=w_k² gives exact +/- commutator diagonal pairing. Strictly increasing moment ratios h_(j+1)/h_j imply positive c_k. Expanding r(k)=h_(k+m)/h_k=1-m(alpha+1)/k+O(k^-2) to the needed second order yields difference m²(alpha+1)/k²+O(k^-3), so the double-counting function gives sorted 4m² coefficient and sharp p=1/2 cutoff. Direct telescoping gives nuclear norm; digamma finite reciprocal sums give strict alpha monotonicity and alpha endpoints. At alpha=0 exact rational forms rise to k=m then decrease, establishing displayed operator norm. I performed independent exact rational tests for four alpha values, m<=8,k<=79, not relying solely on supplied 29,580-check log.
